reviews.review: ...I am so lonely. All the other Viltrumites are scared of me. No one talks to me. No one wants to be my friend, they think I am unstable. They send me from to planet to planet, committing atrocities in their name. And as I get better at it, they fear me more and more. I am a victim of my own success. "Conquest" - I don't even get a real name, only a purpose. I am capable of so much more and no one sees it. Some days I feel so alone I could cry, but I don't. I never do. Because what would be the point? Not a single person in the entire universe would care. Take it to your grave.

R.E.P.O is a lethal-like extraction game at its core, but the developers have jam-packed so much content into this little game that the genre-specific elements that tie these types of games together are nearly completely drowned out, making for a very unique, extremely fun take on this style of game. 

to put it lightly, Lethal Company left too much to be desired from this genre and if you think so too, R.E.P.O is definitely worthy of taking the crown here. from the sheer amount of replayability, the amount of enemies and unique situations, to the Party game atmosphere, this game is just excellent. 

overall, if you have 10 dollars and a group of friends to play with -do it- you really can't go wrong. plus, this dev team deserves the support.  10/10
